Title: Unhandled ValueError crash when creating a task with a 5-digit year (19999-06-14)
Preconditions: User ayamgoreng is logged in and on /tasks/new
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Click + New Task 2. Enter task title and select category 3. Enter 5-digit year 19999-06-14 in Due Date 4. Click Save
Expected Result: System rejects the invalid date format and displays a user-friendly validation error on the form
Actual Result: Server crashes with an unhandled Python ValueError traceback page ('19999-06-14' does not match format '%Y-%m-%d') and breaks return navigation

Title: Task due today (T = 2026-11-21) is misclassified as Overdue instead of Due Today
Preconditions: User ayamgoreng is logged in; system date is 2026-11-21
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Click + New Task 2. Create task 'submit stqa project' with Due Date 2026-11-21 3. View task list on /
Expected Result: Task urgency badge displays Due Today
Actual Result: Off-by-one comparison (due <= today) causes task urgency badge to display Overdue on the exact current date

Title: Re-registering with an existing username and password overwrites previous account records
Preconditions: Account ayamgoreng already exists with saved tasks
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Navigate to /register 2. Enter existing username ayamgoreng and password akusukaayam 3. Click Register
Expected Result: System blocks duplicate registration and shows 'Username already exists' error
Actual Result: Missing username uniqueness check allows re-registration and overwrites/orphans previous account records

Title: Weak password policy accepts single-character-type passwords without complexity validation
Preconditions: User is on /register
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Enter valid username ayamgoreng 2. Enter lowercase-only password akusukaayam (11 chars) 3. Click Register
Expected Result: System enforces password complexity or warns against weak passwords
Actual Result: Account registration succeeds with lowercase-only password without complexity enforcement

Title: Password length check rejects valid 8-character passwords (duplicate root cause of DEF-004)
Preconditions: User submits an 8-character password on /register
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Navigate to /register 2. Enter valid username and an exact 8-character password 3. Submit form
Expected Result: System accepts 8-character password per minimum length rule (>= 8)
Actual Result: is_valid_password() uses strict len(password) > 8 instead of >= 8 and rejects valid 8-character passwords

Title: Dashboard 7-day completion counter excludes tasks completed exactly 7 days ago
Preconditions: Task was completed exactly 7 days prior to dashboard load
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Complete a task with timestamp exactly 7 days ago 2. Open /dashboard
Expected Result: Task is included in 'Completed in the last 7 days' counter
Actual Result: completed_in_last_n_days() uses strict age.days < n instead of <= n and excludes tasks completed exactly 7 days ago

Title: Dashboard completion counter excludes tasks completed within the exact same second
Preconditions: Task completed at the exact same timestamp second as query evaluation
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Complete a task 2. Immediately evaluate completed_in_last_n_days() within the same second
Expected Result: Task is included in completed count
Actual Result: Uses age.total_seconds() > 0 instead of >= 0 and excludes tasks with zero elapsed seconds

Title: Username validation accepts non-ASCII Unicode characters despite ASCII alphanumeric rule
Preconditions: User is on /register
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Enter username containing non-ASCII letter such as 'jöhn' 2. Submit registration
Expected Result: System rejects non-ASCII characters per ASCII alphanumeric specification
Actual Result: Python str.isalnum() accepts Unicode letters and allows non-ASCII usernames

Title: Form label elements lack matching for and id attributes across Login, Register, and Task forms
Preconditions: User opens /login, /register, or /tasks/new
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Inspect form markup or run axe-core audit on /login, /register, and /tasks/new
Expected Result: Every <label> element is programmatically associated with an input via matching for and id attributes
Actual Result: <label> tags omit for attributes and inputs omit id attributes, triggering critical axe-core violations

Title: Stored HTML and XSS injection in task titles via Jinja safe filter
Preconditions: User is logged in and on /tasks/new
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Create task with HTML/script payload in title 2. View task list on /
Expected Result: Task title is HTML-escaped and rendered as plain text
Actual Result: index.html renders task titles using Jinja's |safe filter, enabling stored HTML and XSS execution

Title: Web UI accepts and saves whitespace-only task titles
Preconditions: User is logged in and on /tasks/new
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Enter spaces only ('   ') in Title 2. Click Save
Expected Result: System rejects whitespace-only title with validation error
Actual Result: Web UI saves whitespace-only title without stripping whitespace, contradicting API HTTP 400 validation

Title: Registration form clears entered username after validation error
Preconditions: User is on /register
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Enter valid username and invalid password 2. Submit form
Expected Result: Entered username remains populated so user only re-enters password
Actual Result: Form clears the username field on validation failure, forcing full re-entry

Title: Task completion toggle button uses raw symbol characters without descriptive accessible name
Preconditions: User has at least one task on /
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Inspect completion toggle button on task row
Expected Result: Toggle button exposes descriptive accessible name (e.g. 'Mark task complete')
Actual Result: Button uses raw circle/checkmark characters as its accessible name

Title: Filter dropdowns auto-submit form on onchange during keyboard navigation
Preconditions: User focuses Category or Status select on /
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Navigate filter select options using keyboard arrow keys
Expected Result: Selection changes without unexpected context change until user submits
Actual Result: Inline onchange triggers immediate form submission and page reload on arrow navigation

Title: Category and Status filter selects lack accessible names and Search relies only on placeholder
Preconditions: User is on /
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Run axe-core accessibility scan on task filter controls
Expected Result: All select and search inputs have explicit labels or aria-label attributes
Actual Result: Select elements lack accessible names and search input relies solely on placeholder text

Title: Misleading empty-state message shown when new user has zero tasks and no active filters
Preconditions: Newly registered user has zero tasks and no filters applied
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Log in as new user with no tasks 2. View /
Expected Result: Displays clear empty-account message such as 'You have no tasks yet'
Actual Result: Displays 'No tasks match your filters' even when no filters are active

Title: Navigating to invalid or deleted task edit URL silently redirects without user feedback
Preconditions: User is logged in
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Navigate directly to /tasks/99999/edit
Expected Result: System displays a clear 'Task not found' notification message
Actual Result: System silently redirects to / with no explanatory message

Title: First and last table header cells on task table are empty
Preconditions: User has tasks displayed on /
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Inspect <thead> cells in task table on /
Expected Result: All <th> cells contain descriptive header text or screen-reader labels
Actual Result: First and last <th> cells for toggle and actions columns are completely empty

Title: Missing viewport meta tag forces 980px desktop layout on 375x740 mobile viewports
Preconditions: User opens any page in mobile viewport
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Set viewport to 375x740 px 2. Load /
Expected Result: Page adapts responsively to 375px mobile width
Actual Result: base.html lacks <meta name='viewport'> tag, forcing a zoomed-out 980px desktop layout

Title: Horizontal scrolling required at 320px CSS width due to missing viewport meta tag
Preconditions: User opens any page at 320px width
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Set viewport width to 320px 2. Check horizontal overflow
Expected Result: Content reflows without requiring two-dimensional scrolling
Actual Result: Horizontal scrolling is required at 320px width

Title: Submitting a numeric task title to POST /api/tasks triggers unhandled HTTP 500 error (duplicate: SEC-DEF-002)
Preconditions: Authenticated session on POST /api/tasks
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Send POST /api/tasks with JSON payload {'title': 123}
Expected Result: API returns HTTP 400 Bad Request with validation error
Actual Result: Server crashes with HTTP 500 Internal Server Error due to calling .strip() on integer

Title: Missing user_id ownership check in DELETE /api/tasks/<id> permits cross-user task deletion (IDOR)
Preconditions: User A and User B exist; User B owns task <id>
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Authenticate as User A 2. Send DELETE /api/tasks/<user_b_task_id>
Expected Result: API returns HTTP 404 Not Found and preserves User B's task
Actual Result: SQL DELETE omits user_id predicate and deletes User B's task with HTTP 200 OK

Title: Submitting a numeric username to POST /api/register triggers unhandled HTTP 500 error
Preconditions: Unauthenticated client on POST /api/register
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Send POST /api/register with JSON payload {'username': 12345, 'password': 'Password123'}
Expected Result: API returns HTTP 400 Bad Request
Actual Result: Server crashes with HTTP 500 Internal Server Error due to non-string type handling

Title: Unparameterized SQL LIKE query in GET /api/tasks?q= enables SQL injection exposing other users' tasks
Preconditions: Multiple users exist with private tasks
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Authenticate as User A 2. Send GET /api/tasks?q=' OR '1'='1
Expected Result: Search returns only User A's matching tasks
Actual Result: F-string SQL interpolation allows SQL injection payload to bypass user isolation and expose private tasks

Title: PUT /api/tasks/<id> accepts empty task title when updating a task
Preconditions: Authenticated user owns task <id>
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Send PUT /api/tasks/<id> with JSON payload {'title': ''}
Expected Result: API rejects empty title with HTTP 400 Bad Request
Actual Result: API updates task with an empty title, inconsistent with POST /api/tasks validation

Title: DELETE /api/tasks/<id> returns HTTP 200 ok when deleting a non-existent task ID
Preconditions: Authenticated user; task ID 99999 does not exist
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Send DELETE /api/tasks/99999
Expected Result: API returns HTTP 404 Not Found
Actual Result: API returns HTTP 200 with {'status': 'ok'} despite zero deleted rows

Title: Authenticated pages lack Cache-Control no-store headers allowing Back-button view after logout
Preconditions: User logs in, views /, and clicks /logout
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Log in and view / 2. Click /logout 3. Inspect response headers / browser Back behavior
Expected Result: Authenticated responses include Cache-Control: no-store to prevent post-logout cached viewing
Actual Result: Authenticated responses omit Cache-Control: no-store headers, allowing cached task list display via Back button
